about.description: ETF perpetual market tracking the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS), an equal-weight basket of Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, NVIDIA, Meta and Tesla. Users get synthetic exposure to the MAGS ETF's price rather than ownership of ETF shares or redemption rights, with pricing referencing the ETF's public market price via Lighter's fair price oracle. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC.
